tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background, behind cards and the sidebar.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sidebar, bottom bar. The default content surface.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Sheet, side panel, popover, menu and tooltip: what floats above a card.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Segmented control track, input background, progress bar track.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and active item of the sidebar and list rows.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Dividers and card outlines. Decorative: never the only cue for a control.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Outline of inputs, checkboxes and an off switch. ≥ 3:1 on `surface` and `surface-raised` in both themes.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Text and values on `bg`, `surface`, `surface-raised` and `surface-sunken`.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Labels, captions, the reference beside a value (`/ R$ 4.983`). ≥ 4.5:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Homeowner green. Primary action, active navigation item, links, brand chart marks. As text, only on `surface` or `bg`.

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed of `brand`.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `brand`. In dark the green is light, so the text is dark.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the active sidebar item and selected chips. Text on it: `brand` or `text`.

tokens.name: hero
tokens.usage: The Overview's hero card: the only saturated block on the screen.

tokens.name: on-hero
tokens.usage: Text and values on `hero`.

tokens.name: on-hero-muted
tokens.usage: Labels and captions on `hero`.

tokens.name: hero-line
tokens.usage: Chart line on `hero` (pace curve).

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Under pace, good delta, paid, success. Always with an icon or word.

tokens.name: positive-soft
tokens.usage: Positive badge background. Text on it: `positive`.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Attention: due soon, over pace, near the limit.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Attention badge background. Text on it: `warning`.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Late, over limit, error, destructive action.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Error badge background. Text on it: `danger`.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a `danger` button.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset. ≥ 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Veil behind sheet and dialog.

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Chart grid and axis. Decorative.

styles.name: card-label
styles.usage: Label at the top of a card, in `text-muted`.

styles.name: value-hero
styles.usage: The screen's main number, one per screen.

styles.name: value-sm
styles.usage: An amount in a list row or table.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: A name in a list row, buttons.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Secondary line of a list row, chart legend.

tokens.name: space-0
tokens.usage: No space.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Half step, only inside components: icon↔text, vertical padding of a badge.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between related items: rows of a compact list, buttons side by side.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Card padding on phones, gap between cards on phones, minimum side gutter.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop, card grid gap.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Content area padding on desktop, separation between sections.

tokens.name: space-40
tokens.usage: Breathing room above the page title on desktop.

tokens.name: space-48
tokens.usage: Separation between large blocks, empty states.

tokens.name: space-64
tokens.usage: Top of onboarding and empty screens.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Rectangular badges, checkboxes, chart bars.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, sidebar items, tooltip.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Sheet, side panel, hero card.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills, segmented control, avatars, round icon buttons.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards. In dark, separation comes from `surface` on `bg`.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Sheet, panel, popover, toast.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Dense buttons and inputs, segmented control, filters.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default height of buttons and inputs on desktop.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Primary buttons on phones and in onboarding; minimum touch target.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Full sidebar (≥ 1280px).

tokens.name: sidebar-collapsed
tokens.usage: Icon-only sidebar (1024–1279px).

tokens.name: panel-width
tokens.usage: Desktop detail side panel.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Maximum width of the content area.

tokens.name: bp-tablet
tokens.usage: Below this: bottom bar.

tokens.name: bp-desktop
tokens.usage: From this: collapsed sidebar.

tokens.name: bp-wide
tokens.usage: From this: full sidebar.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover, pressed, colour change.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Segmented pill, a button's success state, toast.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Sheet and panel entering, chart redraw.

tokens.name: ease-standard

tokens.name: ease-exit
